The MongoDB database to connect to (from: Die MongoDB-Datenbank zur Verbindung (von Ihrer Authentifizierung)
Fields to include or exclude (e.g., {\"n: Felder die hinzugefügt oder ausgeschlossen werden sollen (z.B. {"name": 1, "_id": 0})
Document(s) to insert. Can be a single d: Dokument(e) zum Einfügen. Kann ein einzelnes Dokumentobjekt oder ein Array von Dokumenten sein.

Database name. Defaults to the database: Database name. Defaults to the database in the connection. Use List Databases to find it.
Collection name, e.g. \"users\". Use Lis: Collection name, e.g. "users". Use List Collections to find it.
MongoDB query object, e.g. {\"status\":: MongoDB query object, e.g. {"status": "active"}. Use MongoDB Extended JSON for special types: {"$oid": "<24-hex id>"} for an ObjectId, {"$date": "<ISO date>"} for a date.
Field path to read, e.g. \"status\" or \: Field path to read, e.g. "status" or "address.city".
Maximum number of results to return (1-1: Maximum number of results to return (1-1000). Defaults to 100.
Fields to include or exclude, e.g. {\"na: Fields to include or exclude, e.g. {"name": 1, "_id": 0}. Omit to return every field.
Sort order, 1 ascending and -1 descendin: Sort order, 1 ascending and -1 descending, e.g. {"createdAt": -1}.
Number of matching documents to skip, fo: Number of matching documents to skip, for paging. Defaults to 0.
The document _id, e.g. \"65f1c0a2b3d4e5f: The document _id, e.g. "65f1c0a2b3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0". Leave empty when using Filter.
MongoDB query object, e.g. {\"email\": \: MongoDB query object, e.g. {"email": "a@b.com"}; the first match is returned. Leave empty when using Document ID.
One document object, or an array of docu: One document object, or an array of document objects, e.g. [{"name": "Ada"}, {"name": "Alan"}]. Use {"$date": "<ISO date>"} for a date and {"$oid": "<24-hex id>"} for an ObjectId.
MongoDB update operators, e.g. {\"$set\": MongoDB update operators, e.g. {"$set": {"status": "done"}, "$inc": {"views": 1}}. Use MongoDB Extended JSON for special types: {"$oid": "<24-hex id>"} for an ObjectId, {"$date": "<ISO date>"} for a date.
Insert a new document when nothing match: Insert a new document when nothing matches the filter. Defaults to false.
Return the documents after the update. D: Return the documents after the update. Defaults to true.
The full new document, without update op: The full new document, without update operators, e.g. {"name": "Ada", "status": "active"}.
Return the document as it was before or: Return the document as it was before or after the replacement. Defaults to after.
Array of operations, each an object with: Array of operations, each an object with exactly one key: {"insertOne": {"document": {...}}}, {"updateOne": {"filter": {...}, "update": {"$set": {...}}, "upsert": true}}, {"replaceOne": {"filter": {...}, "replacement": {...}}} or {"deleteOne": {"filter": {...}}}. Use {"$oid": "<24-hex id>"} for an ObjectId and {"$date": "<ISO date>"} for a date.
true: run in order and stop at the first: true: run in order and stop at the first failure. false: run every operation and report all failures. Defaults to true.
Array of stages, e.g. [{\"$match\": {\"s: Array of stages, e.g. [{"$match": {"status": "active"}}, {"$group": {"_id": "$category", "total": {"$sum": 1}}}]. Use {"$oid": "<24-hex id>"} for an ObjectId and {"$date": "<ISO date>"} for a date.
Name of the new collection, e.g. \"order: Name of the new collection, e.g. "orders".
Fields and direction, e.g. {\"email\": 1: Fields and direction, e.g. {"email": 1} or {"lastName": 1, "createdAt": -1}. Use "text" for a text index.
Name for the index. Defaults to a name M: Name for the index. Defaults to a name MongoDB builds from the keys, e.g. "email_1".
Whether the indexed values must be uniqu: Whether the indexed values must be unique. Defaults to false.
Name of the index, e.g. \"email_1\". Use: Name of the index, e.g. "email_1". Use List Indexes to find it.
